author: (Evermann & Marsh, 1899)

note.en: A slender 4 cm blenny of algae-covered rubble and finger coral, known here from one 1998 museum specimen at Puerto Vargas (Cahuita); FishBase gives the eastern Caribbean as its range.
note.es: Un blenio delgado de 4 cm de escombros cubiertos de algas y coral dedo, conocido aquí por un espécimen de museo de 1998 en Puerto Vargas (Cahuita); FishBase da el Caribe oriental como su área.

evidence: OBIS: 1 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: OBIS and GBIF museum records (UCR Zoology Museum, LACM) from Limón, Isla Uvita, Cahuita and Puerto Viejo
